0022600009.text: The Spurs (0-1, on a one-game losing streak and 4th in the Southwest, 1 game back, 10th in the West) host the Rockets (1-0, 1st in the Southwest, 3rd in the West). San Antonio is without Jayden Quaintance (out, knee surgery) and Tobias Harris (out, calf strain), while Houston's Reed Sheppard (knee bruise) and Steven Adams (calf soreness) are both listed as day-to-day and are game-time decisions. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, but the Spurs won the 2025-26 season series 3-1, including a 145-120 win in San Antonio on March 8, 2026.
